name: Audio Sonic MCP
description: Runs entirely on your own machine - no API keys, no uploads, no cloud. Turn a YouTube link or a local audio file into a structured sonic signature: BPM, section-by-section musical key, a production profile (vocal presence, transient punch, stereo width), and a 512-dimension CLAP vibe embedding.
author: Ripunjay Kashyap

tools.name: get_sonic_signature
tools.description:
Submits a YouTube URL for sonic analysis and returns immediately.
The pipeline runs in the background — poll get_job_status(job_id) for results.
Typical processing: 20-30s on GPU, ~6-8 min on CPU (Demucs separation dominates).

Args:
    url: YouTube URL of the track to analyze.
    job_id: Optional custom job ID. Auto-generated if omitted.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description:
Returns the current status and payload of a previously submitted job.

Args:
    job_id: The job ID returned by get_sonic_signature.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: Lists all completed and in-progress analysis jobs.
